note: Datasheet requirements -> deterministic probe bindings. Every requirement id of requirements.json appears exactly once: either bound to a probe (with the deck parameters the probe needs) or declared not_testable with the concrete reason. A bound requirement must declare a numeric limit, because the harness judges one measured number per characteristic; behavioural statements and quantities the model family cannot expose (internal nodes, thermal network, oscillator, package) are never stretched onto a probe. Params are deck parameters, never model parameters: the model under test runs with its own defaults.

bindings.not_testable_reason: operating-range statement for a power-stage input the reduced model does not expose (single VIN port, no PVIN), so there is no separate power-stage input to observe
operating-range statement, not a threshold: the harness measures the start voltage (uvlo_rise) but the guaranteed 4.5 V operating minimum is not a datum this model exposes

the reduced model's UVLO hysteresis is a free parameter (UVLO_RISE - UVLO_FALL, default 400 mV) that is not calibrated to the datasheet's 150 mV typical; the harness reports the characteristic untested instead of claiming it
the reduced model's EN input is a high-impedance comparator with no modelled bias-current source, so the datasheet's 1.15 uA / 3.4 uA pin sourcing current cannot be observed at the pin

the extracted requirement declares no numeric limit, and this harness judges numeric limits against measured values; the external-divider path is exercised by the vref and load_regulation probes but this statement is not converted into a PASS
error-amplifier transconductance is an internal small-signal parameter; the reduced model's amplifier is a fixed internally-compensated gm stage with no pin-level stimulus defined in this harness
error-amplifier dc gain is an internal parameter of the reduced model and this harness defines no pin-level measurement of it
the COMP node is internal to the reduced model and is not one of its ports, so the 0.25 V start-switching threshold cannot be measured
the high-side switch current is internal to the converter and the reduced model has no switch branch or PVIN/SW current path, so the 4.2 A - 6.2 A switch limit cannot be observed
the low-side switch current limit is internal and the reduced model has no low-side switch branch to probe
the low-side sink current limit is internal and the reduced model has no low-side switch branch to probe
hiccup is specified in switching cycles of an internal oscillator the reduced model does not implement (it uses a time-constant retry), so cycle counts cannot be observed
thermal shutdown needs a thermal network; the reduced model has no temperature dependence, so junction temperature is not a simulated quantity
the SS/TR pin is not a port of the reduced model and its ramp current is an internal constant, so the datasheet's 2.3 uA sourcing current is not observable
the extracted requirement declares no numeric limit; the soft_start probe observes the resulting ramp but a behavioural 'lower of reference and SS/TR' statement is not a number the harness can judge
SS/TR is not a port of the reduced model and the requirement declares no numeric limit, so the post-shutdown discharge cannot be observed
SS/TR is not a port of the reduced model, so the internal-node matching error against VSENSE at V(SS/TR) = 0.4 V cannot be measured
the extracted requirement declares no numeric limit; the pg_threshold probe observes the open-drain pin state with a pull-up, but a behavioural window statement is not converted into a PASS

the extraction merges the falling (91 %) and rising (94 %) PWRGD thresholds into one [0.91, 0.94] band that no single measured edge answers, and the reduced model's window (+/-10.5 % / +/-8.5 % of VOUT_NOM) is a different pair, so the harness does not claim this characteristic

application-connectivity requirement on the surrounding circuit: the probe decks use a 10 kohm pull-up to a 5 V rail, but a deck constant is not a measurement of the model, so the harness does not claim it
the extracted numeric is a VIN level at which PWRGD becomes defined (1 V), not a pin-level limit; the harness measures pin quantities and cannot judge it
the SS/TR 1.2 V threshold is an internal node of the reduced model and is not a port, so the 'PWRGD low while SS/TR below threshold' condition cannot be observed
the extracted requirement declares no numeric limit and the reduced model's EN port has no internal pull-up current source, so neither a limit check nor a behavioural claim is available
the extracted requirement declares no numeric limit; the soft_start probe observes the ramp (including its overshoot) but a monotonic pre-biased start-up statement is not converted into a PASS
BOOT and PH are not ports of the reduced model, so the bootstrap UVLO threshold cannot be observed
the reduced model has no oscillator (it regulates continuously), so the RT/CLK switching-frequency range cannot be observed
application/package requirement (0.1 uF bootstrap capacitor and soldered thermal pad); not a measurable model quantity
package/mechanical requirement with no numeric limit; the thermal pad connection is not observable in simulation
board-level supply statement with no numeric limit; the reduced model exposes a single VIN port, so the PVIN/VIN supply split cannot be observed
